{{Top|leg}}
'''Nutrient fluid''' was used to sustain the organic [[Brain/Legends|brains]] from seriously injured [[TIE pilot]]s that were transferred into [[Shadow Droid]]s. The brains were placed in a cocoon that was filled with nutrient fluids. The brains of [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr]] [[Monk/Legends|monks]] were placed in [[glassine]] jars that were filled with nutrient fluid.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
